items.title: Inside the race between Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos for control of outer space
items.summary: The Atlantic writer Josh Tyrangiel says Musk and Bezos each want to colonize the moon, mine its resources and launch thousands more satellites. He says their only real competition is each other.
